phase_name: the nine remaining extensions (web, rust, nix, books, z3, typst, python, latex, formal)

objectives.description: Apply the shared per-phase procedure to the 21 declared files
objectives.note: 44 occurrences measured (vs. the plan's Scope Hypothesis of 59 -- drift recorded, not silently absorbed), all 21 files treated. All nine implementation/research skill files (books, latex, nix, python, z3, rust, web x2, plus books' hard variants) share the exact same 'An implement-phase dispatch targets a {domain} task' / 'report the status and let the user re-run the implement-phase dispatch' template already established across Phases 9/12/13, handled via batch sed. The eight simple README/EXTENSION.md 'No dedicated commands. Use core ...' one-liners (rust, latex, typst, z3, python) were handled via one shared sed pattern; nix, web, and formal's richer workflow-diagram READMEs were handled individually. Verified clean afterward by the measurement command restricted to all nine extension roots.

objectives.description: formal/README.md (8 occurrences) -- the densest in this tranche; a research-only extension whose implement-phase prose needed consistent phrasing across 4 separate sentences
objectives.note: All 4 sentences describing the deliberate research-only design (no implementation agents/skills; the implement phase falls through to general-implementation-agent) reworded consistently to 'the implement phase' / 'implement-phase dispatch' framing, preserving the substantive claim (this extension intentionally has no domain-specific implementer) unchanged.

objectives.description: Each extension README's routing table names live research/implementation SKILLS per language, distinguished from a dead command token at each site
objectives.note: No skill name (skill-nix-research, skill-web-implementation, skill-{domain}-research, etc.) was ever a candidate for editing throughout this phase -- none match the measurement pattern (no leading-slash token), confirmed by the same verification used in Phase 9. Only the command-name tokens describing how a user or /orchestrate reaches those skills were reworded.

gate_notes: Gate subset (--only-gate 3,4,24). None of the nine extension roots (books, formal, latex, nix, python, rust, typst, web, z3) report a new FAIL in check-extension-docs.sh. No new FAIL introduced by Phase 14.
